usage: 燒雞 (siu1 gai1) is a noun used to refer to roast chicken as a dish.
You can use 燒雞 (siu1 gai1) to talk about ordering or eating roast chicken in a restaurant.
燒雞 often appears on menus and can be combined with other words to describe portion size or style.
It can be the subject or object in sentences, like '我想食燒雞' (I want to eat roast chicken).
You can also use it when comparing different dishes, for example, '呢度嘅燒雞最好食' (The roast chicken here is the best).

examples.sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅燒雞好好味。
